verdict.rationale: Grok Build documents a curl installer for macOS, Linux and Git Bash, a fullscreen interactive TUI for coding with agents, a CLI reference, and a headless mode. The local agent process can be sandboxed with Landlock or Seatbelt. Hands-on community users praise the TUI and harness, and one ran the binary on Windows in Nushell. Missing for 10: hands-on reports show running past login is gated on a higher subscription tier, and no independent walkthrough of a full local session beyond login.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a coding agent locally from my terminal

citations.quote: curl -fsSL https://x.ai/cli/install.sh | bash   # macOS / Linux / Git Bash
The TUI provides a rich, mouse-interactive, fullscreen experience for coding with agents.
The sandbox limits what the agent process and its children can read, write, and reach on the network (Landlock on Linux, Seatbelt on macOS).
Grok Build is a powerful and extensible coding agent. Use it via an interactive TUI, headlessly in scripts or bots
